backgrounds.desc: You were born into Nobility, and being apart of such has taught you many things from proper introductions, to fine dining, and noble presentation.
backgrounds.langs: One Additional Language of your choice

backgrounds.desc: You are refugee, in one way or another you have been flung from your way of life due to a conflict or by the decision of some king or ruler. You’ve lost everything, with nothing but the clothes off your back you aim for clearer pastures and better future.
